title: A local-scheme section descends to an open neighbourhood
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with i followed by forget to Over X equal to X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. Let H be a functor from abelian etale sheaves on X to abelian etale sheaves on Spec(O_X,x), with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and adj an adjunction of H to direct image along X.fromSpecStalk x. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf on X. Write D_F and c_F for the explicitly constructed neighbourhood diagram and cocone [new-local-stalk-sections-comparison-map]. For every section s of H(F) on the terminal etale object of Spec(O_X,x), there exist an opposite open neighbourhood U and t in D_F(U) such that c_F(U)(t)=s.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree zero, proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to principal opens in an affine neighbourhood of x.

proof.text:
Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x. Principal opens of V containing x
are cofinal among neighbourhoods of x: intersect any neighbourhood with V and use
the principal-open basis of V. The colimit of their coordinate rings is O_X,x.
Apply the degree-zero section assertion of Tag 03Q6 to the identity of V, which is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and to the restriction of F to V. Every section
of the inverse-image sheaf on Spec(O_X,x) descends to a section on one of these
principal opens. This gives the required neighbourhood U and section t. The maps
are the pullback maps given by the inverse-image unit and the local-scheme maps to
the neighbourhoods. Identify the standard inverse image with the displayed H by
uniqueness of left adjoints to the same direct image. This identification respects
the units and therefore identifies its pullback maps with LocalStalkSections.comparison.
Transport the descended section through that isomorphism to obtain the requested
representative. The zero sheaf is included; no henselian or global qcqs hypothesis is needed.
Small affine presentations keep the coefficient universe fixed; empty X has no x. -/

Mathlib Stalk.lean has fromSpecStalkOfMem and its factorization; concrete-category colimit lemmas supply representatives and equality from common restrictions. Upstream SectionContinuity and Sheaf EtaleSetSectionContinuity assume coefficients in universe one above the scheme universe and require a specified affine limit presentation. They do not directly supply the same-universe abelian neighbourhood cocone assertions here.
